alt: Plan-view shaded-relief map of the Fish River basin, USGS gauge 01013500, built from a 116 by 153 cell, 510 m elevation grid. Terrain colour runs from low (dark purple) to high (yellow) over about 385 m of relief. A white dashed line marks the divide; cyan lines are DEM-derived channels with at least 25 square kilometres draining through them, converging on the outlet, which lies at the north side of the map. There is no terrain outside the divide.
